description: CPU and GPU profiles; candidate validation and ordinal reuse; optimized k=500 stress tests

method.cpu_profiler: GNU gprofng, 10 ms timer samples; hardware perf blocked by host setting 4
method.gpu_profiler: Nsight Systems 2026.3.2, CUDA APIs/kernels/memory; about six seconds per workload
method.initial_worker_cpu_caveat: Concurrent Nsight capture adds CUPTI overhead; follow-up profile excludes Nsight
method.cpu_caveat: CPU captures include startup/load and are diagnostic; inclusive CPU categories overlap
method.gpu_caveat: Kernel busy is interval union per device / global kernel window; neither SM occupancy nor unprofiled utilization
method.throughput: All credited throughput runs exclude gprofng and Nsight; full 500-row results
method.direct_caveat: Same query/filter distributions but different pairings; bypasses SQL/MVCC
changes: Expected-linear candidate-position uniqueness check for n>32; reference fallback on OOM
Use cached global ordinals with shard/key validation instead of per-hit binary search
